# TeleportArc

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Movement.Runtime` · assembly `VRFramework.Movement.Runtime` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Movement/TeleportArc.cs#L13)

The thrown arc the player aims along, and what it lands on. Draws a projectile curve from the
hand into the scene and reports the first thing it meets.

The curve bends under a gravity of its own rather than the scene's, so aiming feels the
same in a scene that has turned gravity up for its own reasons.

```csharp
[RequireComponent(typeof(LineRenderer))]
public class TeleportArc : MonoBehaviour
```

## Methods

### DrawTo(Vector3, Vector3) {#drawto-vector3-vector3}

Redraws the arc so it ends exactly on a target, however the player was actually pointing.
A teleport point is a place, not a pixel: once the arc is over one, snapping to it is the
difference between a target the player can hold and one that slips off the edge.
